description: Creates a custom preset that inherits from a system preset, in the BambuStudio user profile directory; it appears in the dropdown after Bambu Studio is restarted. BambuStudio has no plugin API (see bambulab/BambuStudio#9614), so this is the only way to get parameters tuned by an AI into the GUI. Writes a file; an existing preset with the same name is never silently overwritten.

inherits.description: Name of the system (vendor) preset to inherit from.

name.description: Name of the new preset; it appears in the Bambu Studio dropdown.

overrides.description: Parameters to override; each key is a BambuStudio setting name (e.g. layer_height, sparse_infill_density).

overwrite.description: Whether to replace an existing preset with the same name. Defaults to false.

name: bambu_save_user_preset
title: Save a user preset to Bambu Studio
